title: Awakened Marketplace Manifest
description: Validates .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, the catalog of the Awakened Claude Code plugin marketplace. Enforces the fixed marketplace name and owner (D-03, SPEC section 2), N-3 kebab-case plugin naming with the marketplace name prohibited as a plugin name (N-4), in-repo plugin sources under ./plugins/ (D-01, D-02), and MIT-only licensing (D-08). The $id is an identifier only and is never fetched at runtime (HR-6).
$comment: R-4: the official marketplace field set is open-ended and is re-verified at Phase 2 (SPEC section 0), so additionalProperties stays true and only policy-constrained fields are declared. owner.name is pinned because SPEC section 2 fixes the account and expressly excludes another one; leaving it a free string is how the wrong owner would ship. plugins is fixed at exactly nine (SPEC section 4 lineup, ROADMAP V6.3); the converse check - a plugins/<dir> on disk that is absent from this catalog - is a cross-field rule enforced by scripts/validate, as is name-equals-source-basename. The external source object stays open (additionalProperties true); the pin field was verified at Phase 2 (D-24): for git-based sources the official field is sha (40-hex commit), with ref selecting a branch or tag and sha the effective pin when both are set. Both are declared below so the D-10 pin is expressible and checkable.

name.description: GitHub owner, fixed by SPEC section 2. The spec names one account and expressly excludes another, so this is a const rather than a free string.

plugins.description: Catalog entries, exactly nine — the SPEC section 4 Tier-1 lineup.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case plugin name (N-3). The marketplace name is prohibited: a plugin named after the marketplace would be the catch-all N-4 forbids.

source.description: Plugin source: a ./plugins/<name> path inside this monorepo (D-01), or an external source object. The in-repo form's final path segment must equal the entry name; that cross-field check is enforced by scripts/validate.

sha.description: Exact commit pin for a git-based source (D-10, D-24). When both ref and sha are set, sha is the effective pin.

ref.description: Branch or tag reference; superseded by sha when both are present (D-24).
